The petitioner filed this writ petition challenging Ext.P6 order of the Commissioner of Food Safety.
By the impugned order, the manufacture, storage, sales and distribution of the "Keratheeram Coconut Oil" has been prohibited with immediate effect.
2. It is apparent that the petitioner was not heard before the issuance of Ext.P6 order.
Going by the nature of finding that it is not discernible whether any prohibition is required or not.
The petitioner also has a case that no improvement notice has been served on him.

3. In such circumstances, this Court is of the view that treating Ext.P6 as a provisional order, the petitioner is at liberty to raise objections to Ext.P6 within a period of two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
Thereafter, the Commissioner of Food Safety has to pass final orders after hearing the petitioner.
Till a decision is taken, the impugned order shall not be enforced.
The writ petition is disposed of as above.
